ideas.idea: Give /blog its own title/description by splitting into a server component with metadata and a client child
ideas.why: blog/page.tsx is 'use client' so it cannot export metadata and falls back to the layout defaults.

ideas.idea: Create /blog/[slug] pages for individual posts, link them and add to sitemap
ideas.why: Posts render only a title with no URL, so individual posts can't be found or cited.

ideas.idea: Add paid tiers and prices as text on /pricing
ideas.why: The page says only 'Free for up to three people' while the description promises plans for every team size.

ideas.idea: Expand the Docs page with setup steps and links onward
ideas.why: Docs is a single sentence, so it gives readers and machines little to understand.

ideas.idea: Add canonicals to /docs and /blog, ideally via a layout default
ideas.why: The /docs canonical is already a known problem, and the report folds /blog into it.
It is accurate since there is no JSON-LD, but it is boilerplate advice with little effect for a site this small.

ideas.idea: Add lastmod to the sitemap or generate it from app/sitemap.ts
ideas.why: This is accurate, but the sitemap is 4 URLs and the effect is small.

ideas.idea: Make the home page say more, linking each feature to a detail page
ideas.why: It is vague advice that would fit almost any site, though the home page is thin.

ideas.idea: Resolve the contradiction by dropping /pricing from sitemap and navigation if noindex is deliberate
ideas.why: This is the known /pricing noindex problem restated as a branch of the same fix.
